findings.claim: Octopart/Altium 報導：Samsung、SK Hynix 公開表示無塵室擴產受限加上 HBM 需求，供給短缺可能延續到 2027
findings.source: Altium/Octopart, The Memory Market Shift: Shortages, Allocation, and the Road to 2027
findings.excerpt: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have publicly indicated that limited cleanroom expansion capacity and unprecedented growth in high-bandwidth memory demand could extend supply shortages through 2027.

findings.claim: 通路庫存已在近年下調，Anglia 預期需求上升下將出現缺貨與交期拉長，但時點不確定
findings.source: Evertiq, Anglia warns of longer lead times as market picks up
findings.excerpt: With excess stock largely cleared, Anglia expects shortages and longer lead times to emerge as demand continues to rise, though the timing remains uncertain.

findings.claim: ARW 2026Q3 營收 107 億美元年增 39%，高於財測上緣；管理層稱 Global Components 需求廣泛、積壓訂單成長、book-to-bill 遠高於 1；報導稱記憶體漲價約占近期零組件成長三分之一
findings.source: Arrow Electronics 8-K Q3 2026 press release / finviz

findings.claim: ARW Q3 營運現金流 -4.41 億美元，主因支應客戶需求的營運資金投入；另有 Beyond Distribution 外包安排相關費用
Global Electronics Association 調查：2026Q2 認為零組件供給惡化者為改善者 4 倍以上（44% 對 10%）
findings.source: Global Electronics Association blog, The Supply Chain Is Tightening Again

findings.claim: ARW Q3 2026 8-K：book-to-bill 遠高於 1、積壓訂單成長
